title: ExtractedQuestion
description: Structured format for extracted, validated, and reworded exam questions.

id.description: Unique UUID for the extracted question

group_id.description: Group UUID linking sub-questions that share a parent context or diagram

context_latex.description: Shared stimulus/passage or problem context for multi-part questions

choices.description: Array of 4 answer choices formatted in KaTeX

correct_choice_index.description: 0-based index of the correct answer, if known

diagram_description.description: Dense verbal description of any figure/diagram

diagram_type.description: Type of diagram (e.g. geometry, coordinate graph)

needs_human_review.description: True if OCR was garbled, math failed validation, or AI flagged an error

extraction_notes.description: Notes from the structuring or OCR step
